variants.name: default
variants.what: 2-D CPE4R 1 x 50, vertical dofs held, grounded dashpots rho Vs A + force 2 rho Vs A v(t), implicit dt = 1 ms

variants.name: periodic_ties
variants.what: left / right nodes of every level tied in both dofs

variants.name: explicit_2d
variants.what: Abaqus/Explicit, two-node dashpots to fixed points

variants.name: rigid_base
variants.what: base velocity prescribed = incident wavelet: first arrival right, energy trapped

variants.name: force_factor_1
variants.what: equivalent force rho Vs v instead of 2 rho Vs v: half the motion

variants.name: no_dashpot
variants.what: force on a free base without dashpot: double motion, nothing absorbed

variants.name: not_area_scaled
variants.what: per-node dashpot and force = per-unit-area values (tributary area is 2 m2)

variants.name: free_sides
variants.what: vertical dofs free (only the base held vertically), four elements across the width: the column bends like a cantilever (peak +22 %, 0.07 s late, 27 % residual)

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, time of the peak reported as t0 = 0.3 s
